items.title: Anteris' DurAVR THV Demonstrates 1% Heart Failure Hospitalization, Single-Digit Gradients and No Valve-Related Deaths at 1 Year in Patients With Small Aortic Annuli
items.title_zh: PCR London Valves 2026:Anteris生物仿生主动脉瓣DurAVR小瓣环患者1年随访——心衰住院率仅1%、梯度个位数、无瓣膜相关死亡
items.summary_zh: 该研究在2026年11月22日PCR London Valves大会TAVI Hotline专场由Cleveland Clinic的Rishi Puri教授公布,汇总了EMBARK研究及美欧早期可行性研究中100例小主动脉瓣环(平均瓣环面积404±37 mm²)重度主动脉狭窄患者,接受Anteris生物仿生自膨胀瓣膜DurAVR THV治疗的1年随访数据。结果显示平均跨瓣压差仅8.9 mmHg、有效瓣口面积2.2 cm²,未发生中度以上瓣周漏及瓣膜相关死亡;1年因心衰再住院率为1%,显著低于现有商用瓣膜在小瓣环人群中3.5%–6.7%的历史数据,全因死亡率6%(含2例心血管死亡、2例非心源性感染、1例肿瘤及1例车祸),NYHA I/II级比例由术前39%升至96%。该单臂队列由企业自行公布,头对头对照数据仍待正在入组的PARADIGM关键性试验。
items.summary_en: Presented by Rishi Puri (Cleveland Clinic) in the TAVI Hotline session at PCR London Valves 2026 on November 22, this pooled analysis of 100 patients with small aortic annuli (mean annulus area 404±37 mm²) and severe aortic stenosis, drawn from the EMBARK and US/European early feasibility studies, reported 1-year outcomes with Anteris' biomimetic self-expanding DurAVR THV: mean gradient 8.9 mmHg, effective orifice area 2.2 cm², no moderate-or-greater paravalvular leak and no valve-related deaths. Heart failure hospitalization at 1 year was 1%, well below the 3.5%-6.7% historically reported for commercial valves in small-annulus patients, with 6% all-cause mortality and NYHA I/II rising from 39% to 96%. These are company-reported, single-arm pooled results; head-to-head data await the ongoing PARADIGM pivotal trial.

items.title: TARGET Study Demonstrates Sustained Performance and Favorable Safety Profile of the Cardiovalve TR System in High-Risk Patients With Severe Tricuspid Regurgitation
items.title_zh: PCR London Valves 2026:TARGET研究显示Cardiovalve经导管三尖瓣置换系统在高危重度三尖瓣反流患者中疗效持久、安全性良好
items.summary_zh: Venus Medtech旗下Cardiovalve公司在2026年11月22日PCR London Valves大会公布TARGET研究最新随访数据。该前瞻性、多中心、单臂研究共入组157例外科手术高危的症状性重度三尖瓣反流患者(148例完成植入),平均年龄78岁,71%为女性,99%为继发性TR,近40%为重度/极重度(torrential)TR。30天主要有效性终点(植入成功且TR≤2+)与主要安全性终点(30天重大不良事件复合终点)均达标;公司称TR消除效果可持续至3年,3年随访时76.9%患者TR降至无/微量级别。该器械正推进CE认证申请,相关耐久性数据尚未经同行评议发表,为企业自述结果。
items.summary_en: Venus Medtech's Cardiovalve unit presented updated TARGET study follow-up at PCR London Valves 2026 on November 22. The prospective, multicenter, single-arm study enrolled 157 surgically high-risk patients with symptomatic severe tricuspid regurgitation (148 implanted), mean age 78, 71% female, 99% secondary TR and nearly 40% with torrential TR at baseline. Both the 30-day performance endpoint (successful implantation with ≤2+ TR) and the 30-day major-adverse-event safety composite were met; the company reports TR elimination sustained out to 3 years, with 76.9% of patients at none/trace TR at that mark. A CE Mark application is advancing; the durability figures are company-reported and not yet independently peer-reviewed.

items.title: 12-Month Follow-Up Results From the EU TRINITY Clinical Study of LuX-Valve Plus Presented at PCR London Valves 2026
items.title_zh: LuX-Valve Plus欧洲TRINITY研究12个月随访结果在PCR London Valves 2026公布
items.summary_zh: Jenscare Scientific(建实科技/浙江德晋医疗)在PCR London Valves 2026大会上公布其经股静脉三尖瓣置换系统LuX-Valve Plus欧洲TRINITY临床研究的12个月随访结果。该全球多中心单臂研究纳入149例外科手术高危的重度三尖瓣反流患者(20个中心),超75%患者使用55–70mm大尺寸瓣膜。结果显示器械成功率96.6%,可评估患者中80.6%TR降至中度以下,92.1%达到NYHA I/II级,配对KCCQ评分提升约17分、6分钟步行距离增加约39米。该系统可覆盖瓣环最大达70mm,针对大瓣环三尖瓣反流患者提供了更多选择;数据由企业公布,尚待独立同行评议文献确认。
items.summary_en: Jenscare Scientific presented 12-month follow-up from the European TRINITY clinical study of its transfemoral tricuspid valve replacement system, LuX-Valve Plus, at PCR London Valves 2026. The global, prospective, multicenter single-arm trial enrolled 149 surgically high-risk patients with severe tricuspid regurgitation across 20 centers, with more than 75% receiving large valve sizes (55-70 mm). Device success was 96.6%; among evaluable patients, 80.6% had no more than moderate TR and 92.1% reached NYHA class I/II, with paired KCCQ scores improving by roughly 17 points and 6-minute walk distance by about 39 meters. The device's size range (up to 70 mm) targets patients with large tricuspid annuli; the figures are company-reported pending independent peer review.

items.title: Abbott Initiates VOYAGER CE Trial of Investigational Encantor Balloon-Expandable, Software-Guided TAVI System
items.title_zh: 雅培启动VOYAGER CE试验,评估在研软件引导球囊扩张式TAVI系统Encantor
items.summary_zh: 雅培于2026年11月19日宣布启动VOYAGER CE研究,评估其在研软件引导、球囊扩张式经导管主动脉瓣植入系统Encantor治疗重度钙化性主动脉瓣狭窄的安全性和有效性。该研究为前瞻性、单臂、多中心上市前临床研究,首例入组患者在澳大利亚悉尼麦考瑞大学完成,计划在欧洲和澳大利亚入组患者(公司通讯口径在150–300例之间不一致)。Encantor旨在与雅培现有自膨胀瓣膜Navitor形成互补,研究结果将支持其CE认证申请;雅培表示将在未来数月内启动美国关键性试验。Encantor目前在包括美国、欧洲、澳大利亚、加拿大在内的任何地区均未获批上市。
items.summary_en: Abbott announced on November 19, 2026 the start of VOYAGER CE, a prospective, single-arm, multicenter premarket study evaluating the safety and efficacy of its investigational, software-guided, balloon-expandable transcatheter aortic valve implantation system, Encantor, in patients with severe calcific aortic stenosis. The first patient was enrolled at Macquarie University in Sydney, Australia, with the trial planned across sites in Europe and Australia (company-linked sources give enrollment targets of either 150 or 300 patients). Encantor is designed to complement Abbott's self-expanding Navitor platform, and the study is intended to support a CE Mark application; Abbott says it plans to start a U.S. pivotal trial in the coming months. Encantor remains investigational and is not approved for use anywhere, including the US, Europe, Australia or Canada.
